articles.title: Giant Dino Footprints Found — A T. rex Took a Stroll!
articles.summary: Scientists found four huge footprints from an adult T. rex in North Dakota. Each print is about 3 feet long! It's the first time we have a path of T. rex tracks.

articles.title: Have We Found Aliens? Scientists Say 'Not So Fast!'
articles.summary: Scientists asked hundreds of alien experts if we've found alien life. Most said no! Only 6.6% thought we found life on a planet called K2-18b. But they're keeping an open mind.

articles.title: This Comet From Another Solar System Is Full of Alcohol!
articles.summary: A comet from outside our solar system, called 3I/ATLAS, has tons of methanol (a type of alcohol). It's one of the most methanol-rich comets ever seen!
